title: Surreal Mechanical Wall
description: A vast, multi-layered metallic wall stretches across a barren landscape, covered in rows of weathered, rusted panels featuring painted masks, silhouetted creatures, crosses, and mechanical orbs. In the dramatic sky above, a giant red sun glows amid dark swirling clouds, multiple moons, and distant mountains.
